name: EOD 2026-06-19
body:
> Eod · Summit Az · 2026-06-19

Friday. Summit-only session: GSC audit, blog launch, Elementor template build and QA.

# Summit Plumbing Pros AZ
See [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub).
- Published the site's first 5 blog posts on summitplumbingpros.com: Signs of Hard Water, Signs of a Hidden Water Leak, Outdoor Faucet Leaking, Signs You Need a New Water Heater, How to Prevent Clogged Drains. Each has a focus keyphrase, Yoast fields, internal links to Chandler/East Valley pages, a Quick answer lead, FAQ and summary table. Drafts were re-localized from Utah to Arizona.
- Made 5 branded featured banners (1400x730) with [Higgsfield](lib:brain-higgsfield) (10 credits).
- Built an Elementor Pro "Single Post" theme template (the hello-elementor theme had none, which is why featured images did not show).
- QA: removed 3 competitor mentions and one low-authority link, verified all links. Added a no-competitor and verify-links rule to [SEO Blog Writing Standards](lib:brain-seo-blog-writing-standards). Built `Summit-Blog-Content-Tracker.csv`.

# Summit Utah (summitplumbingut.com)
- The GSC "not indexed" audit (46 pages) belongs to the Utah property: a soft-404 (/404-page/ returns 200) and about 17 thin city pages "Crawled, currently not indexed". No changes made.

# Follow-ups
- Request indexing for the 5 new AZ blog URLs.
- Decide ongoing instant-indexing method (plugin vs Scott's setup, see [Instant Indexing Setup](lib:brain-instant-indexing-setup)).
- Optional: delete 5 superseded photo attachments.
- Utah: fix the soft-404 and strengthen or consolidate the thin city pages.
